title: Special Gem Amulets
description: Transforms vanilla minerals and bows into powerful custom amulets using modern 1.21.11 data-driven item mechanics.
body:
# 💎 Amulet RPDP (Resource Pack / Data Pack)

A modern, highly optimized resource pack for Minecraft that transforms standard vanilla minerals and bows into unique, beautiful **Custom Amulets** without replacing the original items! 
By leveraging the new **Data-Driven Items** system introduced in recent Minecraft versions, this pack ensures complete compatibility and vanilla fallback safety.
# ### 🗂️ Features & Amulet Catalog
When an item has specific `custom_data` applied, its model dynamically switches to a custom amulet. If the data is missing, it looks like a normal vanilla item!

* **Comet Amulet** ── 🌟 Applied to **Coal** (`amulet: "comet"`)
* **Saturation Amulet** ── 💎 Applied to **Diamond** (`amulet: "saturation"`)
* **Village Amulet** ── 💚 Applied to **Emerald** (`amulet: "village"`)
* **Wealth Amulet** ── 🪙 Applied to **Gold Ingot** (`amulet: "wealth"`)
* **Magnet Amulet** ── 🔗 Applied to **Iron Ingot** (`amulet: "magnet"`)
* **Echo Amulet** ── 🔮 Applied to **Lapis Lazuli** (`amulet: "echo"`)
* **Shadow Amulet** ── 🤍 Applied to **Nether Quartz** (`amulet: "shadow"`)
* **Lava Amulet** ── 🔥 Applied to **Netherite Scrap** (`amulet: "lava"`)
* **Archer Amulet** ── 🏹 Applied to the **Bow** (`amulet: "rift"`)

# 🗂️ Crafting & Survival Acquisition
Every single custom amulet in this pack has its own functional shaped crafting recipe integrated into the data pack, allowing players to naturally obtain them during survival gameplay.

⚡ Comprehensive Amulet Functions & Abilities
The data pack runs event-driven logic loops (.mcfunction) that constantly check the player's inventory and item components. When a specific amulet is held or triggered, the backend code executes the following unique mechanics:

🚀 Comet Amulet (Coal Core)
Vertical Velocity Modification: Activating this function launches the player straight up into the air.

Damage Negation Loop: The code tracks the player's falling state, completely wiping out all fall damage upon impact.

Explosion Trigger: At the exact touchdown coordinates, a localized explosion command (minecraft:explode) is executed, dealing area-of-effect damage to enemies.

💎 Saturation Amulet (Diamond Core)
Status Effect Injector: Activating this function applies a continuous high-tier Saturation status effect to the player's entity data, instantly replenishing the hunger bar and saturation levels during combat or exploration.

💚 Village Amulet (Emerald Core)
Reputation & Hero Loop: Holding or triggering this amulet running its dedicated script simulates an instant "Hero of the Village" status effect and boosts player village reputation variables, dynamically lowering trading costs with nearby villagers.

🪙 Wealth Amulet (Gold Ingot Core)
Piglin Pacification & Luck: The function modifies the player's detection traits, forcing Piglins to remain passive as if the player is wearing gold armor. Additionally, it injects temporary high-tier Luck attributes to modify chest loot tables.

🔗 Magnet Amulet (Iron Ingot Core)
Entity Attraction Script: Runs a spatial query function centered on the player, calculating the vector distance of nearby dropped item entities and smoothly teleporting/pulling them directly into the player's pickup radius.

🔮 Echo Amulet (Lapis Lazuli Core)
XP Manipulation & Foresight: Activating this script hooks into the player's experience variables, providing a chance to duplicate or preserve experience points when enchanting, or converting nearby mob particles into bonus XP drops.

🤍 Shadow Amulet (Nether Quartz Core)
Invisibility & Sneaking Protocol: Triggering this function executes a stealth routine. While sneaking, the data pack grants complete invisibility and removes the player's footstep particles from mob detection logic, allowing flawless stealth execution.

🔥 Lava Amulet (Netherite Scrap Core)
Fire Immunity & Propulsion: Much like the Comet Amulet, this function launches the player forward/upward, but adds absolute Fire Resistance to the entity attributes, allowing the player to safely navigate and detonate inside lava pools.

🏹 Archer Amulet (Bow Core)
Dynamic Override Engine: Integrates state-driven overrides for the bow drawing animation phases (0.0, 0.65, 0.9).

Projectile Buffs: The data pack hooks into the fired arrow entity, increasing its base velocity and applying customized particle trails via underlying component data traits.
